name: task-context-manifests-never-curated
title: PARKED: Nothing ever requires a task's spec manifests to be curated, so sub-agents dispatch with no spec context
description: Preflight deliberately exempts a lone pristine _example scaffold at every status, so a task can be planned, started, implemented, and archived with uncurated manifests. Sub-agent dispatch reads those manifests first, so the degradation is silent.
creator: sdelmas
